phase_name: Authority Evaluation Production Wiring Independent Verification
summary: Independently verifies Phase 147O.1's claim to have closed AESIC-O-01. Reconstructed the pre-147O.1 gap directly from git show 01178382's own diff and current production source, rather than trusting either report's prose. Built an independent production-flow model before reading 147O.1's own tests, then authored 11 freshly-designed tests (tests/test_phase_147o2_authority_evaluation_production_wiring_independent_verification.py) that do not import or call 147O.1's own test module. The central discriminator: 147O.1's own automated suite only ever calls run_decision_session_*/run_governance_record_publish handler functions in-process against a monkeypatch.chdir-ed tmp_path -- never a real OS process boundary, despite its own report (S18) narrating a manual separate-process reproduction that was never captured as a reproducible test. This phase adds two subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pcae', ...])-based tests reproducing the full lifecycle (configured-eligible and unconfigured-backward-compatible cases) across six-plus genuinely separate OS processes each, confirming Stage 1/Stage 2 reachability, AER/canonical-pointer persistence, CHGR authority_basis_claimed population exactly matching the deployed Decision Template's citation text, and idempotent restart replay reporting 'consumed' disposition without minting a second AER. Independently reconstructed AESIC-N-01 (canonical pointer cross-key confusion) directly against AuthorityEvaluationRecordStore by forging a tampered pointer file (not via the AES service, isolating the storage layer's own guarantee), confirming read_canonical does follow the pointer's own embedded package_id rather than the caller's query key -- then exhaustively enumerated (via AST scan, not text search) every production call site of read_canonical: exactly two (service.py's evaluate_stage_2, argument always internally generated as f'prp-{uuid.uuid4().hex}'; and diagnostics.py's summarize_package, read-only), confirming production wiring added zero new call sites and AESIC-N-01's reachability was not expanded. Independently discovered and characterized a distinction 147O.1's report does not draw explicitly (though its own tests are consistent with it): an evaluation *outcome* never gates lifecycle continuation (an ineligible Stage 2 result still produces a pending readiness disposition), while a genuine Stage 2 *integration failure* (e.g. malformed template) does block readiness construction, fail-closed -- this is contract-compliant failure-handling, not outcome-gating, and is disclosed by 147O.1's own TestFailureSemantics test. Independently discovered one new Minor finding not disclosed by any predecessor phase -- 147O.2-F-1: AuthorityEvaluationRecordStore's _safe_name treats '.' as a safe character, so a package_id of '..' is not rejected and, used as a bare directory component, breaks single-level path containment in _record_path -- resolving one level above the intended records/<package_id>/ subdirectory (still fully contained within .pcae/authority-evaluation/records/, never outside the repository). Confirmed not reachable on any production write path (every writer generates package_id internally); reachable only, read-only, via 'pcae aesic status --package-id ..', which was independently confirmed to degrade safely (reports 'no canonical record', never raises or leaks). Recorded for deferred repair alongside AESIC-N-01, not repaired in-phase (src/pcae/** is frozen by this phase's No-Go boundary). Also independently confirmed via AST inspection: PublicationCoordinator contains zero aesic/authority_evaluation references of any kind; the aesic zone has no reverse dependency on commands; both commands-zone callers (decision_session.py, aesic_status.py) import only pcae.aesic.composition/diagnostics/storage, never pcae.authority_evaluation directly, exactly matching the .pcae/policy.toml commands->aesic edge 147O.1 declared. Runtime capability unaffected throughout (Observed / observe / unavailable, verified via pcae runtime inspect before and after). No production repair, no contract amendment, no schema redesign, no architecture-policy change, no chapter certification claimed. Overall Verdict: AUTHORITY EVALUATION PRODUCTION WIRING VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS.

Zero new call sites added by Phase 147O.1's production wiring.
